data.answer: The company laptop is returned, and the device is wiped within 3 business days of an employee's exit.
All system access is revoked within 4 hours of the person's exit time. Additionally, shared secrets that the person had access to are rotated within 2 business days.
Yes, a web application firewall filters all inbound traffic.
When a bank forwards a request from an individual for access, correction, or erasure, Nimbus Labs responds to the bank within 15 days.
Riya Sharma is the named privacy lead.
Nimbus Labs designs Nimbus Ledger Sync for alignment with India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023, but this is a design goal rather than a certification or a compliance statement.

Nimbus Labs completed a SOC 2 Type II examination covering the Nimbus Ledger Sync platform for the audit period from 1 January 2026 to 30 June 2026, with the final report issued on 14 August 2026 by Harlow & Pike LLP, but the chunks do not provide an audited annual report or credit rating.
Passwords must be at least 14 characters. Administrator accounts must use hardware security keys in addition to passwords, and shared accounts are not permitted.
The latest incident response tabletop drill took place on 4 June 2026.
